name: mySugr - Diabetes Tracker Log
description:
Simplifying life with diabetes

Download now! The mySugr app stores all your important diabetes data from connected devices, integrations, and manual entries, in one convenient place.

APP FEATURES  

-        Personalized Homescreen: Track your diet, medication, carb intake, blood glucose levels, and more in one place.
-        Easy Connections: Your connected Accu-Chek blood glucose meter automatically logs your blood sugar readings into the app. (The availability of devices may vary by country or region)
-        More: Reports, clear blood sugar graphs, estimated HbA1c, and secure data backup.	

mySugr Glucose Insights

Now available in selected countries (Lithuania, Kuwait, Qatar) mySugr Glucose Insights is a new device within the mySugr app that activates when you connect an Accu-Chek SmartGuide sensor:
-        Real-time Glucose Values: View your glucose levels directly on your mobile device (also: Apple Watch).
-        Prediction Features: Stay ahead of potential glucose excursions with real-time predictions.
-        Customizable settings and alarms: Meet your personal needs by adjusting the target range, setting alarm values for high and low glucose, and more.

For more information on country availability, visit your local Accu-Chek website.

PRO FEATURES  
Take your diabetes therapy to the next level!
-        mySugr Bolus Calculator: Receive precise insulin dose recommendations (available in select countries with mySugr PRO).
-        PDF & Excel reports: save or

name: MacrosFirst - Macro Tracker
description:
MacrosFirst is the most powerful macro tracker, food logger, calorie counter, and meal planner—designed to help you easily achieve your health and fitness goals, no matter your diet or fitness level.

[ SET & TRACK YOUR MACRO GOALS ]

• Create custom daily and meal-level macro goals, including unlimited custom meals, to fit any schedule or diet plan.

[ AUTO-CALCULATE SERVING SIZES ]

• Automatically calculate serving sizes to hit your specific macro targets with precision.

[ LOG FOODS & MEALS IN SECONDS ]

• Search a database of over 3M+ verified foods or scan barcodes with the barcode scanner for quick, accurate tracking—and easily copy meals or entire days between dates.

[ SCAN NUTRITION LABELS ]

• Instantly import nutrition facts by scanning food labels with your camera—no manual entry required.

[ TRACK MACROS & NUTRIENTS ]

• Get detailed breakdowns of calories, protein, carbs, fats, and more, and customize your view to track the metrics that matter most.

[ ANALYZE YOUR PROGRESS ]

• Track body weight trends and compare them with your food intake over time using detailed progress reports.

[ SHARE MEALS & STAY CONNECTED ]

• Share meals, foods, and recipes with friends and family, and view their daily logs for mutual support.

[ CONVERT ALCOHOL INTO MACROS ]

• Allocate alcohol calories as carbs, fat, or a combination of both, keeping your calorie and macro tracking perfectly aligned.

▶ GET EVEN MORE WITH PREMIUM ◀

[ UNLIMITED DAILY GOALS ]

• Set personalized mac

name: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
description:
Wysa is used by more than a million people from all walks of life. Self-help techniques, inspired from research-backed and widely used approaches like CBT (cognitive behavioral) and DBT (dialectical behavior), alongside meditation, are employed to support you with everyday wellbeing challenges like low mood, stress, anxiety, sleep and a whole range of other wellbeing needs.

Talking to Wysa is empathetic, helpful, and will never judge. Your identity will remain anonymous and your conversations are privacy protected.

Wysa is an emotionally intelligent chatbot that uses AI to help with the everyday emotions you express. Unlock techniques that help you cope with everyday challenges. For extra support, take guidance from qualified mental health professional. Leveraging behavioral techniques, mental health professional help you identify, design and work towards goals that are aligned with your true values.

Here's a look at what you can use Wysa for:

- Vent and talk through things or just reflect on your day
- Practice self help techniques inspired from approaches like CBT (Cognitive Behavioral) and DBT (Dialectical Behavior) to build resilience in a fun way
- Deal with loss, everyday worries, or conflict, using conversational coaching tools
- Relax, focus and sleep peacefully with the help of mindfulness exercises

93% of the people who talk to Wysa find it helpful. So, talk to Wysa!

Wysa has lots of cool tools:
- Build confidence and reduce self-doubt: core mindfulness, visua
